     8	def fit_quadratic_trend(df: pd.DataFrame, latitude: float, longitude: float) -> dict:
     9	    """OLS fit of air_temperature = c0 + c1*t + c2*t**2 (t = year - 2000)
    10	    at one grid point.
    11	
    12	    Returns a dict with keys: coef, std_err, residual_sd, fitted, n.
    13	    """
    14	    selected = df[(df["latitude"] == latitude) & (df["longitude"] == longitude)]
    15	    n = len(selected)
    16	    if n == 0 or n < 4 or selected["year"].nunique() < 3:
    17	        raise ValueError("at least 4 rows and 3 distinct years are required")
    18	
    19	    years = selected["year"].to_numpy()
    20	    t = years.astype(float) - 2000.0
    21	    y = selected["air_temperature"].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    22	    X = np.column_stack((np.ones(n), t, t * t))
    23	
    24	    # The validation above ensures that the quadratic design matrix has full
    25	    # column rank, so the normal-equation covariance formula is defined.
    26	    beta = np.linalg.solve(X.T @ X, X.T @ y)
    27	    residuals = y - X @ beta
    28	    rss = float(residuals @ residuals)
    29	    residual_sd = float(np.sqrt(rss / (n - 3)))
    30	    covariance = (rss / (n - 3)) * np.linalg.inv(X.T @ X)
    31	    standard_errors = np.sqrt(np.diag(covariance))
    32	
    33	    fitted_values = X @ beta
    34	    fitted = {
    35	        int(year): float(value)
    36	        for year, value in zip(years, fitted_values)
    37	    }
    38	
    39	    names = ("c0", "c1", "c2")
    40	    return {
    41	        "coef": {name: float(value) for name, value in zip(names, beta)},
    42	        "std_err": {
    43	            name: float(value) for name, value in zip(names, standard_errors)
    44	        },
    45	        "residual_sd": residual_sd,
    46	        "fitted": fitted,
    47	        "n": n,
    48	    }
    49	
    50	
    51	def main() -> None:
    52	    data = Path(__file__).parent / "data" / "a1b_north_america_annual.csv"
    53	    result = fit_quadratic_trend(pd.read_csv(data), latitude=15.0, longitude=225.0)
